Engineer, Programmer and DIY Enthusiast

Hi! I'm [[TODO: first name]]!

Thank you for visiting my website! I am currently a Software Development Engineer at Amadeus IT Group, and I studied a Masters in Electronic and Information Engineering at Imperial College London.

On this website you will see some of the projects I have worked on (this page itself being one of those projects!), as well as some of my interests and hobbies. I started my engineering journey when I was 10, learning Java in order to develop add-ons (known as mods) for the now popular game, Minecraft. Ever since, I have been on the pursuit of constant learning and self-improvement, which is reflected in my projects and many hobbies.
